question: Under a 105000-event full paid-tape session, does PRE_MIGRATION_RUNNER_WATCH produce at least one independent mint episode per covered hour, and do realizable runtime outcomes remain durable rather than top-heavy?

budgetSelection.selectionRule: Raise only the event cap enough to cover the latest measured 60-minute demand with about 4.5 percent headroom. Subscription policy, strategy gates, exits, episode identity, and economic bars remain unchanged.

subscriptionPlan.billingRule: PumpPortal charges 0.01 SOL for each completed 10000-event block; the 5000-event remainder adds no projected completed-block charge.
subscriptionPlan.budgetHeadroomRule: Cover 60 minutes at the latest measured 1673.536 paid events per minute with about 4.5 percent event headroom.

episodeIdentity: telemetry_run|mint; same-mint reentries within a run count as one episode

throughputCheckpoint.gradeOn: cumulative valid V5 full-coverage runtime sessions

requirements: realized PnL after removing top 3 winning episodes > 0
no single run contributes more than 60% of total positive PnL

prohibitions: No live broadcast enablement from this experiment.
No entry-gate, exit-rule, targeted curve-band, or TTL changes while evidence is collecting.
No grading on MFE, maximum excursion, or duplicate same-mint reentries.
V1 through V4 rows cannot count as V5 evidence.
Any later change to curve floor, budget, entry logic, or exit logic starts a new pre-registration.
